thread:
incident-bot: [INCIDENT OPEN] ID INC-20260315-42 — P0 inference routing errors detected in us-west-2. Error rate spike 2:14 UTC. Paging oncall.
oncall-bot: <@sre-josh> is on-call. Bridge created: https://meet.internal/bridge/INC-20260315-42
sre-josh: joining bridge. seeing a flood of 502s from model-router service; tokens failing while routing to ded-1 pool.
eng-ram: i'm on the logs, looks like kernel selection fallback triggered due to OOM on a subset of pods. rolling back recent kernel patch to test.
maria-product-ops: tagging for customer-impact tracking — which customers saw errors vs latency? cs-anna pls advise.
cs-anna: we have 3 active accounts with errors >40%: AcmePay, EduGlobal, Shoplark. cs-anna will open interim tickets and offer status updates.
ops-bridge-bot: mitigation attempts: autoscale triggered, failed allocations 9/12; starting model-variant fallback to smaller quantized variant (q4_0) for affected routes.
sre-josh: enabling fallback to q4_0 now. will monitor token success rate.
eng-ram: applied rollback to kernel patch on 3 nodes. restarting model-router pods gradually. if unhealthy, we'll redirect traffic to ded-secondary.
incident-bot: Timeline note: detected 02:14 UTC, mitigation started 02:18 UTC, fallback enabled 02:21 UTC.
cs-anna: notifying AcmePay & Shoplark support contacts now. sending short update: "We are investigating errors impacting inference routing; mitigation in progress. Updates every 30m."
maria-product-ops: good. please include rough ETA for full resolution when we have it. tagging @cto-evan for exec awareness.
cto-evan: seen. want a brief post-incident plan after resolution. prioritize: customer comms, rollback root cause, and regression test before kernel reapply.
sre-josh: success metric: error rate <1% for 10m and tail latency within 2x normal. currently error rate down to 8% after fallback.
eng-ram: next step: if fallback stabilizes, we'll keep q4_0 for 2 hours, then attempt staged reintroduce of kernel with aggressive monitoring.
ops-bridge-bot: attaching current logs snippet:
```
[02:16:12] model-router: allocation failed on node g4-12a: cuda OOM
[02:16:13] kernel-selector: falling back to generic path
[02:17:05] autoscaler: failed to allocate 2/4 pods
```
cs-anna: update sent to customers at 02:30 UTC — they acknowledged. AcmePay asked for a postmortem and timeline for prevention.
sre-josh: we hit success metric at 02:46 UTC. marking incident as mitigated. keeping bridge open for 1h to watch for regression.
incident-bot: INCIDENT MITIGATED at 02:46 UTC. switching to post-incident coordination channel.
maria-product-ops: ok team — let's convert this to a postmortem thread. attendees needed: SRE owner, Eng owner, Prod owner, CS owner. propose postmortem 2026-03-16 15:00 UTC (5/6 attendees confirmed). anyone conflict?
eng-ram: that works for me. I'll present the kernel change timeline and the rollbacks.
cs-anna: works. I'll prepare customer impact table and a draft external note.
sre-josh: works for me. i'll compile traces, alerts, and exact error windows.
cto-evan: i'll join the first 15m to sign off on customer follow-ups.
maria-product-ops: action items we'll track in the postmortem doc and as follow-up Jira tickets. quick list here, owners, and rough due dates:
```
- ACTION-1: Root cause RCA writeup (owner: eng-ram) — due 2026-03-18
- ACTION-2: Hardening: prevent OOM regression via pre-emption and unit test (owner: sre-josh) — due 2026-03-25
- ACTION-3: Customer comms: finalize and send RCA to impacted customers (owner: cs-anna) — due 2026-03-17
- ACTION-4: Status page recap and incident timeline update (owner: maria-product-ops) — due 2026-03-16
- ACTION-5: Add monitoring alert for kernel fallback frequency (owner: eng-ram) — due 2026-03-20
- ACTION-6: Credits / goodwill offer review for impacted customers (owner: cs-anna + finance) — due 2026-03-19
```
maria-product-ops: please put these into the postmortem doc and create corresponding Jira tickets. include expected rollback plan if we reapply kernel.
eng-ram: created draft postmortem doc: https://docs.internal/postmortems/INC-20260315-42-draft — will add more detail before the meeting.
sre-josh: created observability board and attached flamegraphs / trace links in the doc.
cs-anna: customer comms draft for review:
```
Hi <Customer>,
We experienced routing errors affecting inference requests on 2026-03-15 between 02:14–02:46 UTC. We mitigated the issue by automatically failing requests to a smaller model variant and rolling back a recent kernel change. We are investigating root cause and will follow up with a full RCA and actions within 48 hours. We apologize for the disruption.
```
maria-product-ops: suggestion — include an explicit remediation/timeframe paragraph and offer a 10% credit for impacted billing period; cs-anna to confirm with finance.
cs-anna: confirmed with finance — 10% credit approved for AcmePay and Shoplark; EduGlobal asked for engineering follow-up meeting instead.
cto-evan: include a technical appendix in the customer RCA that explains mitigation and planned long-term fix; avoid internal-only kernel implementation details.
eng-ram: noted. will produce a non-sensitive appendix.
maria-product-ops: assigning follow-ups: eng-ram (RCA + appendix), sre-josh (monitoring + unit tests), cs-anna (customer drafts + credits), maria-product-ops (status page + scheduling). please update Jira IDs once created.
ops-bridge-bot: created Jira tickets: INC-42-1001, INC-42-1002, INC-42-1003, INC-42-1004, INC-42-1005.
sre-josh: quick pre-req: we need to add load-shedding for model-router to avoid full OOM; i'll prototype this as part of HARDEN ticket.
eng-ram: reapplying kernel will require a canary with 5% traffic for 24h and automated rollback. adding canary plan to ACTION-2.
maria-product-ops: postmortem meeting invite sent to attendees for 2026-03-16 15:00 UTC. agenda in doc: timeline, RCA, mitigation, action owners, customer comms.
cs-anna: i'll share the 'external RCA' draft with AcmePay today (02:55 UTC) and Shoplark after sign-off. EduGlobal wants meeting — scheduling now.
sre-josh: final note — thanks for quick responses everyone. logging final observability artifacts and metrics to the postmortem doc for audit.
maria-product-ops: closing thread — after the postmortem we'll re-open here for follow-up confirmations. please ack when you create/assign the Jira ticket assigned to you.
eng-ram: acknowledged, Jira INC-42-1001 created for RCA.
cs-anna: acknowledged, INC-42-1003 for customer comms.
sre-josh: acknowledged, INC-42-1002 for hardening.
cto-evan: acknowledged. I'll review the customer-facing RCA before it goes out.
incident-bot: INCIDENT CLOSED (mitigated -> postmortem scheduled)."
